title: RJ's Stone
description: This pack alters the appearance and texture of stone materials.
body:
This texture pack **improves stone textures**  
  
That includes:  
**Stone, Granite, & Diorite**
  
This pack is 100% original and made by me!
![Stone Wall](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea12fcb1669abd5a57e465663dcf54a1c1bdee0d.png)
